mapper.sql: sys51_specific_menu_person_id AS specific_menu_person_id, sys51_specific_menu_id AS specific_menu_id, sys51_person_id AS person_id, f_get_empTrans(sys51_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm')||' '||f_emp_kor_nm(sys51_person_id) AS person_nm, sys51_use_yn AS use_yn, sys51_note AS note, sys51_specific_work_cd AS specific_work_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys51_specific_menu_person (sys51_specific_menu_person_id, sys51_specific_menu_id, sys51_person_id, sys51_use_yn, sys51_note, sys51_specific_work_cd) VALUES (#{specificMenuPersonId}, #{specificMenuId}, #{req.personId}, #{req.useYn}, #{req.note}, #{req.specificWorkCd})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys51_specific_menu_person p WHERE sys51_specific_work_cd = #{specificWorkCd} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys50_specific_menu m WHERE m.sys50_specific_menu_id = p.sys51_specific_menu_id AND m.sys50_specific_work_cd = #{specificWorkCd} AND m.sys50_company_id = #{companyId})
